description: Root causes with five-why chains and confirmation state.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.statement: Balancing current sizing did not account for the cell self-discharge spread observed after extended parked periods.
five_why_chain: Cell voltage spread exceeded expectation after parking
Balancing did not converge during the available window
Available balancing current was lower than the spread growth rate
Balancing current was sized on cycling data, not parked self-discharge data
The sizing input specification did not include a parked self-discharge case

records.statement: Laser focus offset drifted outside the process window following a fixture change, reducing weld penetration.
five_why_chain: Weld resistance measured above limit
Weld penetration was below specification
Laser focus position was offset from nominal
The fixture change altered the standoff distance
Focus verification was not included in the fixture change control plan

records.statement: Controlled atmosphere furnace dew point excursion during the affected production week produced through-wall porosity in the braze joint.
five_why_chain: Coolant leak detected at pack leak test
Braze joint contained through-wall porosity
Joint was formed with oxide contamination present
Furnace atmosphere dew point exceeded the qualified window
Dew point alarm threshold was set above the qualified limit after the process change

records.statement: Cure cycle temperature at the transferred production location ran below the qualified window, producing under-cured compound with reduced radial stiffness.
five_why_chain: Radial stiffness measured below the lower specification limit
The rubber compound was under-cured
Cure temperature was below the qualified window
The transferred oven profile was not requalified for the new oven
The process transfer checklist did not require cure profile requalification

records.statement: Vent membrane was contaminated during handling before installation.
five_why_chain: Vent flow verification failed
Vent membrane was obstructed
Contamination was present on the membrane surface
The vent was handled without protective packaging at the station
The work instruction did not specify handling protection
